attributes.action: Ensure the continuation of funding for UK Youth Parliament beyond March 2027
attributes.background: Ensure that funding continues for UK Youth Parliament. It is a hugely important collection of young people, who all strive to make positive change for the benefit of all young people. We must make sure young people’s voices are not silenced.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Fund the UK Youth Parliament beyond 2027
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/780584
